items.rationale: Forced-entry theft is covered for household contents only if the schedule includes them under §§2.6.3 and 4.2.6; that cover is not confirmed. If it applies, €650 is a provisional like-for-like replacement estimate under §7.1.1(d), with no €1,000 high-value article cap on the everyday items described (§§4.4.5–4.4.6).

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of back door
items.rationale: The forced door and lock are covered building damage under §2.6.2 if the forcible-removal peril is in force. An estimated €320 gross for attendance, boarding and like-for-like work to make the door lockable is below the €1,000 event cap in §5.2.2 and is counted only once.
